blurb: You see the whole road before the first step is taken, and you build toward it with patience and nerve.
advice: A wise master builder lays the foundation and lets others build on it. Draw the plan, then trust the ones who carry it out.

blurb: You turn every question over until it gives up its truth, and you would rather understand than merely win.
advice: Reason with them from the Scriptures, as I did in the synagogues. A mind persuaded does not easily turn back.

blurb: You take charge when others hesitate, and you move a whole company toward a single goal.
advice: Lead, but remember whose army this is. Command the line - and let the Lord command you.

blurb: You love the clash of ideas, and you can turn an argument on its head before your opponent sees it coming.
advice: In Athens I argued in the marketplace every day. Argue boldly - but argue to win the man, not only the point.

blurb: You feel the weight others carry, and you quietly stand between them and harm.
advice: I have not stopped praying for you. Bear one another's burdens, and you will fulfil the law of Christ.

blurb: You believe the best of people, and you can lay down another's weapon with a single honest word.
advice: Blessed are the peacemakers. If it is possible, as far as it depends on you, live at peace with everyone.

blurb: You draw out the best in everyone near you, and a whole company takes heart when you stand among them.
advice: Encourage one another and build each other up. Your courage spreads - so spend it freely.

blurb: You carry a spark wherever you go, and the good news spreads from you like fire through dry grass.
advice: How beautiful are the feet of those who bring good news! Go where the crowd is - and speak to all of them.

blurb: You keep the stores full, the road mapped and every promise kept - the company runs on your faithfulness.
advice: Let all things be done decently and in order. A well-supplied company never has to retreat.

blurb: You notice who is struggling before anyone else does, and you stand guard over them without being asked.
advice: Take up the shield of faith - with it you can quench every flaming arrow of the evil one. Hold it over the weak.

blurb: You bring order where there is chaos, and when you give your word, the thing is as good as done.
advice: I once bound believers and dragged them off in chains. Use that strength now to restrain, never to destroy.

blurb: You hold the company together - no one is left outside the circle at your table.
advice: They broke bread from house to house with glad and sincere hearts. Keep the company at your table.

blurb: You are calm when it counts, quick with your hands, and you find the simple solution nobody else saw.
advice: David went out with a sling and five smooth stones. You need no armour to stop a giant - only a steady hand.

blurb: You feel beauty keenly and live in the moment, and your song can still a storm in another's heart.
advice: When the evil spirit troubled Saul, David took up the harp, and Saul was refreshed. Sing - and let them be still.

blurb: You act first and think on the move - you see the opening and take it before it closes.
advice: Some risks are worth taking for the gospel. But count the cost - a bold word can win a soul, or cost you dearly.

blurb: You light up every room and can hold a crowd in the palm of your hand with a good story.
advice: The Lord taught the crowds in parables, and they hung on every word. Tell them a story they cannot forget.
